pages.title: String Resonance Loom
pages.text: Plucks cosmic strings into fundamental quantum strings and weaves them into membranes.$(br2)$(thing)Tier 4$() machine.

Two very different 'strings'. A $(thing)cosmic string$() is a hypothetical crack in spacetime left by the early universe, light-years long and thinner than a proton. A $(thing)fundamental string$() is string theory's basic object: each vibration mode is a particle. The $(item)String Resonance Loom$() turns one into the other.
$(thing)Made on the Extreme Assembly Table$() (it is also a crafting table). The recipe pages at the end of this entry - and JEI - show the pattern.

$(thing)Machine data$(): a single-block machine (5 item and 2 fluid inputs, 1 and 0 outputs).$(br2)$(thing)Makes$(): Brane Tension Fiber, Cosmic String Lens, Dimensional Stabiliser Matrix, M-Brane, Quantum String.
